articles.title: BMW iX4 Electric SUV Design Patented In India: What To Expect?
articles.excerpt:
BMW seems to be planning to introduce a new coupe-style electric SUV in India. It has filed a design patent for the iX4, which debuted globally last month and is based on the Neue Klasse electric platform. Although BMW has not officially confirmed the BMW iX4 India launch, the design patent raises the possibility of the German marque aiming to expand its electrified range here. Let's take a closer look at some possible key specs of the iX4 if it goes on sale in India.
2027 BMW iX4 Front Profile (Representative Image)
BMW iX4: Exterior, Interior
The global-spec model, which was revealed in early October 2026, gets a sportier stance. A spoiler integrated into the boot lid adds to its coupe-SUV profile. Compared to the iX3 SUV, the iX4 gets a sloping roofline. Some of the key design elements of the international-spec iX4 are dual-pod headlamps and an iconic kidney grille. The car rides on 20-inch alloy wheels. The M60 variant gets additional design elements and larger wheels.
2027 BMW iX4 Rear (Representative Image)
From the inside, the BMW iX4 looks similar to the iX3 SUV, with features such as Panoramic Vision display and a 17.9-inch touchscreen and Panoramic Vision display. Other amenities include powered front seats, wireless connectivity, and charging. The car is 4,782mm long, 1,895mm wide, and 1,607mm tall, and has a wheelbase of 2,897mm.
